prompt: Composition: Full-width relevant image with heading overlay, visible next section, no text/media split hero. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Set headings in Oswald and reading text in Work Sans; condensed heading with open sans text. Use Ink and Electric Yellow: page #181818, text #FAFAFA, accent #F4E84A, secondary surface #303030, text on accent #111111. Use body 18px, heading 28px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
